title: NFL Football
description:
Tampa Bay Buccaneers at Cincinnati Bengals
Cincinnati Bengals host Tampa Bay Buccaneers in a regular-season NFL Week 1 game at Paycor Stadium. The Bengals finished the previous season third in AFC North with an 6-11 record while the Buccaneers finished second in NFC South with an 8-9 record.

title: NFL Football
description:
Washington Commanders at Philadelphia Eagles
The Eagles host the Commanders in Week 1 NFL action at Lincoln Financial Field. The Eagles enter this matchup after splitting their 2025 head-to-head series 1-1. The Eagles finished last season with an 11-6 record, while the Commanders finished 5-12.
